name: OpFin
decision: 15 September 2026: retain and refine the existing OpFin monogram; adopt Indigo, Apricot and Warm Ivory. Do not substitute the Open Path or Pipiya marks.

logo.rule: Derive resized and recoloured assets from the existing monogram, preserving its silhouette. No invented replacement mark. Interface app-name text is not represented as the supplied vector wordmark.
